b: I don’t know how or what has happened to my Instagram account, but in September, my reach went down so much just from one day to the other. I used to get about 3K likes on each post on average and reaching at least 50K people. Then, one day, it all changed. So I reached just 20K people on average and a maximum of 1K likes. I noticed that my posts used to reach 70% non-followers or even more. And then I reached just 15% non-followers.
And I hadn’t changed anything about my content. I’ve posted quality content consistently for the past 6 years, and I’ve only experienced these things now, on my 6th year.
Now, another change happened. Just 5 days ago, it changed again. Now I only reach 2% non-followers on average! I reach just 5-10K people and get around 400 likes per post.
Does anyone know what could’ve happened? Or what I can do to change it? It’s so demotivating…
